title: Monthly MRR Performance Review
subtitle: Period 2026-05  |  source table: ex_saas_metrics
governing_thought: Sustained growth in MRR highlights resilience despite regional challenges.

key_messages.text: Total MRR reached $1.56M in 2026-05, up +1.2% from $1.54M in 2026-04.
Enterprise plan leads at $805k, representing 51.6% of total MRR.
Business plan experienced a decline of -$10k compared to the prior month.
North America remains the top region at $532k, accounting for 34.1% of total MRR.
North America saw a decline of -$14k versus the previous month.

sections.action_title: Total MRR reached $1.56M in May, marking a peak month performance.
sections.narrative: In May 2026, total MRR increased to $1.56M from $1.54M in April, reflecting a growth of +1.2% or +$18k. This performance represents a seasonal peak, matching the highest MRR recorded in the past year. The trend shows consistent growth over the last several months, indicating a strong upward trajectory in monthly recurring revenue.
bullets: May 2026 MRR matches the peak of $1.56M.
April 2026 MRR was $1.54M, showing steady growth.
Recent months indicate a positive trend in MRR performance.
sections.so_what: Sustained growth in MRR highlights strong market demand and effective customer retention strategies.

sections.action_title: Enterprise leads with $805k, showing a $20k increase from April.
sections.narrative: In May 2026, the Enterprise plan dominates with a total MRR of $805k, representing 51.6% of total MRR. The Business plan follows at $570k, experiencing a decline of $10k from the previous month. The Starter plan increased by $9k to reach $184k, marking it as the biggest mover among the plans.
bullets: Enterprise plan contributes 51.6% of total MRR with $805k.
Starter plan grew by $9k to $184k, the largest increase.
sections.so_what: Focusing on the Enterprise plan's growth can drive overall revenue stability.

sections.action_title: North America leads MRR at $532k, but LATAM grows by $21k.
sections.narrative: In May 2026, North America dominates with an MRR of $532k, representing 34.1% of total MRR across regions. LATAM shows the most significant growth, increasing by $21k to reach $270k, while EMEA and APAC also experience modest gains. However, North America declines by $14k compared to the previous month, indicating potential challenges in maintaining its lead.
bullets: North America: $532k MRR, 34.1% of total MRR.
LATAM grows by $21k, the largest increase among regions.
EMEA and APAC see smaller gains of $7k and $3k, respectively.
sections.so_what: Focus on LATAM's growth potential while addressing North America's declining trend.

recommendations: Increase focus on the Enterprise plan to sustain its $805k contribution to total mrr.
Implement targeted strategies to recover the $10k decline in the Business plan.
Enhance marketing efforts in North America to address the $14k decline in the region.
Analyze customer feedback to identify and resolve issues affecting mrr growth.
sources: ex_saas_metrics (384 rows), measure: mrr, period 2026-05 vs 2026-04; figures verified against the database.
